rows.grounds: compound of bhava (existence), ambhodhi (ocean), and pota (boat); object of vrajāmaḥ
main verb expressing the collective act of taking refuge

items.question: What refuge-worthy vessel should be approached to cross the ocean of existence?
premises: The ocean of existence presents a condition requiring a means of crossing.
A refuge-worthy boat serves as a reliable support for crossing that ocean.
Those lacking devotion and discernment cannot provide such refuge.
items.inference: Therefore we approach the refuge-worthy boat across the ocean of existence.
items.plain_english: We approach the refuge-worthy boat that carries one across the ocean of existence.
